data: In the leftmost plot, what is the value of the normalized erasure for the red line with circles when the average lag is approximately 11?

The leftmost plot corresponds to the en→de MT system trained on full sentences. The red line with circles represents the 'lm-greedy' strategy. To find the value of the normalized erasure for this line at an average lag of approximately 11, I need to locate the point where the x-axis value is around 11 and read the corresponding y-axis value. The value appears to be approximately 1.4.
